summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K reporting routine ATM sales and bitcoin treasury updates. It disclosed sales of 231,324 MSTR shares for ~$42.9M net proceeds and 1,412 STRC shares for $0.1M, with $26.3B and $19.5B remaining capacity respectively. The company also acquired 535 BTC for $43M at $80,340 average. There is no special situation such as a merger, tender, activist, restructuring, or other transformative event.
